description: Mint a presigned R2 PUT URL so you can upload a photo and reference it from a log_learning, log_built_this, or append_to_learning call. Three-step flow: (1) call this with content_type + content_length; (2) PUT the bytes to the returned put_url with the EXACT same Content-Type and Content-Length headers; (3) pass the returned public_url into a write tool's photos[] or screenshots[] array. URLs expire in 5 minutes. Allowed types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif. Max 5 MiB. Throttle: 10 uploads/hr per API key. Requires TOKENMAXXEN_API_KEY env var.

content_length.description: Exact byte length of the file you're going to upload. Must match the PUT request's Content-Length header exactly — R2 rejects mismatches.

content_type.description: MIME type. One of: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif.

kind.description: Default 'learning-photo'. Organizes R2 keys into per-kind prefixes.

name: request_upload_url
